Subject: Updated Schedule for Thursday's Data Skills Workshop

Dear Participants,

We are writing to inform you of a change to the schedule for Thursday's Data Skills Workshop. The hands-on practical session, originally planned for the morning, will now take place in the afternoon from 1:30 to 4:00 p.m. The morning will instead feature the presentation and discussion segments.

Registration will still open at 8:45 a.m. in the main lobby, and lunch will be provided for all attendees. Please remember to bring a fully charged laptop, as it will be required for the practical exercises.

We apologize for any inconvenience and look forward to seeing you on Thursday.

Best regards,
Elena Morris
Workshop Coordinator
task: Write a professional email explaining a fictional workshop schedule change: the practical session moves to the afternoon, registration remains at 8:45, lunch is included, and participants should bring laptops.
